g.text: A useful follow-up identifies the inspection or test needed to support a stronger claim.
For citation checks, judges orapproval triage: which serious errorspass? What happens when supportfails? Independent components canshare blind spots. Request failuresand adjudication procedures.

Request baseline, task population;exclusions, sample, uncertaintyand full human effort.Distinguish adoption, pilot,estimated opportunity andrealized outcome. Retain disclosuredates when comparing firms.

Clarify production scope, entitlements,model/data versions and stop conditions.A company affiliation does not establishdeployment of every discussed technique.Mechanism and reported scale do notby themselves establish effectiveness.

Keep unresolved terms explicit: “crunchable”, “roundedness”, reversed reactive/proactive wording and Comet/NatWest.Sonar’s roughly 50K-line example lacks model, workload and benchmark conditions; its confidence product is conceptual.Kepler’s rough retrieval settings are incomplete, so do not turn them into defaults. The failure study’s expected-lossproduct lacks defined events, conditioning and severity units; incident rankings and growth claims lack denominatorsand methods. These are clarification topics, not established thresholds, prevalence or expected-loss estimates.
Source context retained from OpenAI, Bridgewater, Kepler, Sonar, failure-study and banking notes.
